newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX Corp Q1 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX Corp Q1 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Results are "as reported" and include charges to cover an enhanced pension plan offer to employees and other one-time items in both Q1 1997 and Q1 1996.
Adjusted earnings per share, excluding these charges, were $0.92 in Q1 1997 versus $0.83 for the 1996 quarter. The First Call consensus estimate for Q1 1997 was $0.90 per share.

Q1 1997 reported results include after-tax charges of $243.6 million, or $0.56 per share, for the enhanced pension plan offer. Q1 1996 reported results include charges of $66.5 million after taxes, or $0.16 per share.

Reported first quarter 1996 results include gain from a change in accounting for directory advertising revenues and expenses, partially offset by certain charges resulting in a net gain of $4.0 million after taxes, or $0.01 per share.

Reported first quarter 1996 results also include a change in presentation of certain taxes other than income and include a one-time after-tax gain of $45.8 million, or $0.11 per share, for sale of NYNEX's interest in Vanstar Corp.

Certain first quarter 1997 results were reclassified to account for charges previously recorded in connection with various legal contingencies and settlements of audits of affiliate transactions and sales taxes.
Adjusted net income was $403.1 million for Q1 1997 and $361.5 million for the 1996 period.
Adjusted operating revenues were $3.38 billion in Q1 1997 and $3.32 billion for the 1996 period.
